title: (Updated) Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
summary: Microsoft Clipchamp is adding an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI video creation feature, defaulting to disabled. The feature is now only available from Clipchamp Home. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action needed to keep the feature disabled.
body:
Updated November 19, 2026: We have updated the content. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and Why:]

Microsoft Clipchamp is introducing an admin policy control for the Clipchamp AI video creation experience, also known as Clipchamp 'Generate a video' or 'Create a video' in Copilot Create. This control helps organizations manage which users can access the AI-powered video creation capability. This admin policy will roll-out with default access disabled. 

Note: As of 19 Nov 2026, the AI video creation feature has been updated to be only available from Clipchamp Home, and removed from Copilot Create & the Clipchamp Editor app.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by early December 2026.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Who is affected:

- Users who have access to Clipchamp Create a video / Generate a video experiences.- Admins who manage Microsoft 365 app policies.Platforms/Services:

- Microsoft Clipchamp- Microsoft 365 admin center policy managementWhat will happen:

- Admins will be able to use policy management to control access to Clipchamp AI video project creation.- If your organization wants to disable access, no further action required.- If your organization wishes to enable employee access to this feature, the organization admin will have to disable the ‘Turn off Clipchamp AI video project’ policy[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No action is required if your organization would like to disable access to the Clipchamp Create a video / Generate a video feature. To enable access after rollout, admins can follow the steps in this support article How to enable or disable features in Clipchamp for users in your organization | Microsoft Support and disable the policy ‘Turn off Clipchamp AI video project’.

[Compliance considerations:]

QuestionAnswerDoes this change include an admin control?Yes. Admins can use policy management to control access to Clipchamp AI video project creation.Does the change provide end users a new way of interacting with generative AI?No. This is not a new generative AI feature. The Create a video experience is an existing feature; this update adds admin control for managing user access.----------------------------For Processing Do Not Delete------------------------------

Do you need to update your Service description: No

Post Publish Date: 10/14/2026

Change type: Feature

Product marketing manager: vivnguyen@microsoft.com

Major Update: No
bodyHtml:
Updated November 19, 2026: We have updated the content. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and Why:]

Microsoft Clipchamp is introducing an admin policy control for the Clipchamp AI video creation experience, also known as Clipchamp 'Generate a video' or 'Create a video' in Copilot Create. This control helps organizations manage which users can access the AI-powered video creation capability. This admin policy will roll-out with default access disabled. 

Note: As of 19 Nov 2026, the AI video creation feature has been updated to be only available from Clipchamp Home, and removed from Copilot Create & the Clipchamp Editor app.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by early December 2026.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Who is affected:

  • Users who have access to Clipchamp Create a video / Generate a video experiences.
  • Admins who manage Microsoft 365 app policies.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft Clipchamp
  • Microsoft 365 admin center policy management

What will happen:

  • Admins will be able to use policy management to control access to Clipchamp AI video project creation.
  • If your organization wants to disable access, no further action required.
  • If your organization wishes to enable employee access to this feature, the organization admin will have to disable the ‘Turn off Clipchamp AI video project’ policy

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No action is required if your organization would like to disable access to the Clipchamp Create a video / Generate a video feature. To enable access after rollout, admins can follow the steps in this support article How to enable or disable features in Clipchamp for users in your organization | Microsoft Support and disable the policy ‘Turn off Clipchamp AI video project’.

[Compliance considerations:]

QuestionAnswer
Does this change include an admin control?Yes. Admins can use policy management to control access to Clipchamp AI video project creation.
Does the change provide end users a new way of interacting with generative AI?No. This is not a new generative AI feature. The Create a video experience is an existing feature; this update adds admin control for managing user access.
